description: SMHI's latest hourly air temperature from every reporting weather station in Sweden, on a map from Smygehuk to Abisko, with the warmest and coldest stations. Statistics: a straight-line trend of temperature against latitude, with a 95% band for the line (and a wider one for a single station), so you can see how much colder each degree north is this hour and how sure that slope is. One hour is a snapshot; height and coast also matter. Quality G is checked, Y is suspect or not yet checked.
name: Temperature across Sweden now
